# [AQUA]{.acronym-literal}-E: Authenticator Employment QM {#authenticator-employment-quality-model}

::: {.model-intro .employment}
**[AQUA]{.acronym-literal}-E** has the same quality factors and subfactors as [**[AQUA]{.acronym-literal}-A**](#authenticator-quality-model). The difference lies only in their definitions, which are documented in the [**Description**](#employment-table).
:::
